details.summary: British Conservative politician and sixth Secretary General of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) 1984-1988
details.life: Was born 6 June 1919 in London and passed away 9 July 2018 in Bledlow, Buckinghamshire, England. He was the son of Rupert Victor John Carington, Captain in the Grenadier Guards, and Sybil Marion Colville, lady-in-waiting to Mary, Princess Royal and Countess of Harewood. On 25 April 1942 Carrington married Iona Ellen McClean. They had two daughters and one son.
